chunks.ar: كان في مدينة رجل يعيش من السرقة،
chunks.en_old: In a city lived a thief
chunks.en_new: In a city lived a thief

chunks.ar: وله قرد علمه أن يؤدي حركات مضحكة أمام الناس.
chunks.en_old: with a trained monkey that performed amusing tricks.
chunks.en_new: with a trained monkey that performed amusing tricks.

chunks.ar: اعتاد الرجل الذهاب إلى الأسواق،
chunks.en_old: He used it to distract marketgoers
chunks.en_new: The man used to go to the markets,

chunks.ar: وكان يستعمل القرد ليشغل الناس بينما يبحث عن فرصة للسرقة.
chunks.en_old: while looking for a chance to steal.
chunks.en_new: and he used the monkey to distract people while he looked for a chance to steal.

chunks.ar: وفي يوم رأى بائعًا يحمل ملابس قديمة مستعملة.
chunks.en_old: One day he saw a seller offering old, worn clothes.
chunks.en_new: One day he saw a seller carrying old, used clothes.

chunks.ar: نادى البائع على بضاعته طويلًا، لكن أحدًا لم يرغب في شرائها.
chunks.en_old: No one wanted them,
chunks.en_new: The seller called out his wares for a long time, but no one wanted to buy them.

chunks.ar: تعب أخيرًا، فجمع الملابس في صرة وجلس ليستريح.
chunks.en_old: and the weary seller wrapped the clothes in a bundle and sat to rest.
chunks.en_new: At last he grew tired, so he gathered the clothes into a bundle and sat down to rest.

chunks.ar: اقترب اللص من البائع وجعل القرد يقفز ويلعب أمامه.
chunks.en_old: The thief made his monkey leap and play before the seller.
chunks.en_new: The thief came up to the seller and made the monkey jump and play in front of him.

chunks.ar: ضحك البائع، وصار يتابع حركات الحيوان باهتمام.
chunks.en_old: While the seller watched, amused,
chunks.en_new: The seller laughed and watched the animal's tricks closely.

chunks.ar: وفي تلك اللحظة مد اللص يده وأخذ صرة الملابس من دون أن ينتبه الرجل.
chunks.en_old: the thief quietly stole the bundle.
chunks.en_new: At that moment the thief reached out and took the bundle of clothes without the man noticing.

chunks.ar: أخذ اللص القرد والصرة إلى مكان خال.
chunks.en_old: The thief carried the monkey and bundle to a secluded spot.
chunks.en_new: The thief carried the monkey and bundle to a secluded spot.

chunks.ar: فتحها ورأى الملابس البالية،
chunks.en_old: He rewrapped the rags
chunks.en_new: He opened it and saw the worn out clothes,
chunks.note: wrong action, belonged to next chunk

chunks.ar: ثم جمعها من جديد داخل قطعة قماش جميلة غالية الثمن،
chunks.en_old: in costly, beautiful fabric
chunks.en_new: then wrapped them again in a beautiful, expensive piece of cloth,

chunks.ar: حتى يبدو ما بداخلها أثمن مما هو في الحقيقة.
chunks.en_old: to make the contents seem valuable.
chunks.en_new: so that what was inside would look more valuable than it really was.

chunks.ar: ذهب إلى سوق آخر وعرض الصرة للبيع بسعر منخفض.
chunks.en_old: In another market he offered the bundle cheaply,
chunks.en_new: He went to another market and offered the bundle for sale at a low price.

chunks.ar: وضع شرطًا غريبًا: لا يجوز للمشتري فتحها قبل دفع المال.
chunks.en_old: with one strange condition: the buyer must not open it before paying.
chunks.en_new: with one strange condition: the buyer must not open it before paying.

chunks.ar: كان يريد أن يظن الناس أن بداخلها شيئًا ثمينًا جدًا.
chunks.en_old: He wanted people to imagine valuable contents.
chunks.en_new: He wanted people to think something very valuable was inside.

chunks.ar: رأى رجل قطعة القماش الجميلة، فأعجبته وفكر أنه وجد صفقة رائعة.
chunks.en_old: A buyer admired the elegant wrapping, thought it a bargain,
chunks.en_new: A man saw the beautiful cloth, liked it, and thought he had found a great bargain.

chunks.ar: اشترى الصرة من غير أن يفحص ما فيها،
chunks.en_old: and purchased it without inspecting it,
chunks.en_new: He bought the bundle without checking what was in it,

chunks.ar: وأخذها إلى بيته وهو يتوقع أن يبيعها بربح كبير.
chunks.en_old: hoping to resell at a profit.
chunks.en_new: and took it home, expecting to sell it for a big profit.

chunks.ar: سألته زوجته عما اشترى،
chunks.en_old: His wife asked about the purchase.
chunks.en_new: His wife asked him what he had bought,

chunks.ar: فأخبرها عن الثمن القليل والربح الذي ينتظره.
chunks.en_old: Hearing of the low price and hoped-for profit,
chunks.en_new: and he told her about the low price and the profit he was expecting.

chunks.ar: قالت: «كيف تشتري شيئًا لا تعرف ما بداخله؟
chunks.en_old: she asked why he bought an unopened parcel
chunks.en_new: She said, "How can you buy something without knowing what is inside?

chunks.ar: ولماذا يبيعه صاحبه بهذا الرخص إذا كان ذا قيمة؟»
chunks.en_old: and why anything valuable would be sold so cheaply.
chunks.en_new: And why would its owner sell it so cheaply if it were worth anything?"

chunks.ar: فهمت الزوجة أن وراء الصفقة خدعة،
chunks.en_old: She recognized the trick
chunks.en_new: The wife understood that there was a trick behind the deal,

chunks.ar: وحذرته من شراء الأشياء المسروقة أو المجهولة.
chunks.en_old: and warned him against stolen or unknown goods.
chunks.en_new: and warned him against buying stolen or unknown goods.

chunks.ar: أما اللص فقد أخذ المال ورحل مع قرده،
chunks.en_old: The thief left with the money and monkey,
chunks.en_new: As for the thief, he had taken the money and left with his monkey,

chunks.ar: وبقي المشتري مع صرة من ملابس قديمة لا تستحق ما دفعه.
chunks.en_old: while the buyer remained with old clothes worth less than he had paid.
chunks.en_new: and the buyer was left with a bundle of old clothes not worth what he had paid.
